user.title: Scent Diffuser Setup
user.description: Choose how to connect your scent diffuser.

ble_scan.title: Select Bluetooth Device
ble_scan.description: Select your scent diffuser from the list of discovered devices. Bluetooth provides local control with no cloud account required. All features are available including fan control and real-time status updates.

cloud.title: Aroma-Link Cloud Login
cloud.description: Connect via the Aroma-Link cloud service. Requires an Aroma-Link account and internet connection. Only available for Aroma-Link diffusers (not ShinePick). Note: Fan control and real-time status updates are only available via Bluetooth.

gw_password.title: Device Password (optional)
gw_password.description: If your device requires a 4-character password (set previously in the manufacturer's app — Scent Marketing or Scent Tech / ScentLab), enter it here. Leave blank if the device is unprotected.

error.probe_failed: Could not connect to the selected device to identify it. Make sure it is powered on and in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy that can connect (passive proxies such as Shelly cannot), then try again.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported diffuser
abort.unsupported_gatt:
{name} does not match any diffuser family this integration supports. If it is a diffuser, please open an issue at {issues_url} with the manufacturer, the app it uses, and this Bluetooth layout:

```
{gatt}
```

init.title: Bluetooth refresh
init.description: Seconds between Bluetooth reads of this diffuser (60-3600, default 300). Each read connects once and holds the connection for about 10 seconds, during which the phone app cannot connect and one connection slot on the Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in use. Reads below 300 seconds connect the same way.
